北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天体感 29℃，出门记得带伞，小心闷热哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and feels like 29°C, remember your umbrella and stay cool.

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波中雨，体感 29℃ 湿度极高，带好雨具，出行小心。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has moderate rain, feels 29°C and very humid. Bring rain gear and be careful.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨，体感 30℃ 略闷热，出门记得带雨具。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain, feels a bit muggy at 30°C. Don't forget your umbrella.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州小雨，体感 29℃ 较湿润，带好雨具，保持好心情。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has light rain, feels humid at 29°C. Bring rain gear and stay cheerful.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天体感 29℃，有点闷哦，记得多补充水分。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels 29°C and a bit stuffy. Remember to hydrate.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 29℃ 湿度大，出门带伞以防万一。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels 29°C and humid. Take an umbrella just in case.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 26℃ 湿度高，出行注意添减衣物。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels 26°C and humid. Dress appropriately for your outings.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 33℃ 略热，记得多喝水防暑哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels 33°C and a bit hot. Drink plenty of water to prevent heatstroke.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 26℃ 挺舒适，出门享受好天气吧。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels 26°C and quite pleasant. Enjoy the good weather!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 30℃ 阳光好，注意防晒，多补充水分。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feels 30°C. Enjoy the sun, protect from it, and stay hydrated.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴热 33℃，注意防晒补水，小心中暑哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and hot at 33°C. Protect from sun, hydrate, watch out for heatstroke!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗体感 18℃，湿度高，早晚温差大注意保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny, feels 18°C and humid. Big temperature swing, dress warmly.
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 24℃，北风 4级，小心风大哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels 24°C with 4-level north wind. Watch out for strong winds.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 23℃ 舒适宜人，享受这好天气吧。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels 23°C and pleasant. Enjoy the lovely weather!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 27℃ 湿度大，东南风 4级，注意防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels 27°C and humid. South-easterly wind level 4, mind the wind.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 29℃ 湿度大，出门记得带伞哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels 29°C and humid. Remember your umbrella when you go out.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 28℃，湿度适中，保持好心情哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels 28°C with moderate humidity. Stay in good spirits!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天，体感 29℃ 湿度大，出门记得带伞哦。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is cloudy, feels 29°C and humid. Remember your umbrella when you go out.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪中雨，湿度 100%！出门带伞防湿滑，注意安全。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has moderate rain and 100% humidity! Take an umbrella, watch out for slippery roads.
